repository.description: Repository is the project's Forgejo repository, owner/name.

merge_rule.description: MergeRule: auto merges a clean agent pull request without a human, human waits for an approver.

objects.description: Objects names who creates and reconciles the project's repository objects: factory (registration) or seed (the infra repository and the seed; factoryd only reads).

agents.description: Agents: coder lets agent tasks run, none sends every issue to the human lane and refuses tasks.

process.description: Process names the file processes/<name>.yaml the project's cards pass; required with agents coder, not allowed with agents none.

template.description: Template names the directory templates/<name>/ registration seeds the empty repository's main with; a factory project's only.

audit.description: Audit runs the process's audit stage on the project's pull requests (ruling 188); absent: it does not.

notify.description: Notify are the Forgejo users told about the project's cards; empty: the project's approvers.

approvers.description: Approvers are the Forgejo users who may authorize the project's spend in the console (approve its merges and resource requests, accept and start its plans) and invite its members; empty: the policy's approvers.

namespaces.description: Namespaces are the cluster namespaces the project deploys into.

namespace.description: Namespace is one of the project's namespaces.

path.description: Path is the repository directory applied into it, such as deploy/staging.

hostname.description: Hostname is the environment's public host name, if any.

items.description: Environment is one Flux Kustomization: path of the repository applied into namespace (ruling 157), and the public hostname, if any (ruling 155).

environments.description: Environments are the project's deploy directories, one Flux Kustomization each.

cpu.description: CPU bounds CPU requests and limits, such as 2 or 500m.

memory.description: Memory bounds memory requests and limits, such as 4Gi.

storage.description: Storage bounds the persistent volume claims' requests, such as 10Gi.

quota.description: Quota is each namespace's ResourceQuota; absent: project_default's. Stricter wins: bounded by policy.yaml's project_default.quota, each value at most the policy's; a looser file is rejected.

secrets.description: Secrets are secret/key entries: each namespace gets the secret with a random value for the key when it is missing.

monthly_eur.description: MonthlyEUR caps a calendar month (UTC), reservations and accrued cost together, in net EUR.

server_types.description: ServerTypes are the Hetzner server types a task may commission.

max_count.description: MaxCount is how many servers may run at once.

volume_max_gb.description: VolumeMaxGB is the largest volume per server: 0 for none, else at least 10.

envelope.description: Envelope bounds what the project's tasks commission in the agent cloud project without a human; absent: envelope_default. Stricter wins: bounded by policy.yaml's envelope_default, each number at most the policy's, each server type one it lists; a looser file is rejected.

monthly_eur.description: MonthlyEUR is the fixed monthly line for standing resources.

server_types.description: ServerTypes are the server types a standing resource may have.

max_count.description: MaxCount is how many standing servers may exist at once.

standing.description: Standing bounds the project's standing resources; absent: project_default's. Stricter wins: bounded by policy.yaml's project_default.standing, each number at most the policy's, each server type one it lists; a looser file is rejected.

egress.description: Egress are the host names outside the cluster the project's namespaces may reach, on 443 only; absent: none. A factory project's only: its network policy is registration's.

read.description: Read reads the collaborators and assignees (the trust gate) and the webhooks where its user administers the repository.

actions.description: Actions lists the Actions jobs and registers the runners; agents coder only.

merge.description: Merge merges an approved pull request; agents coder only.

tokens.description: Tokens name the seeded secrets factoryd reaches a seed project's repository with; a factory project's are registration's own.

check_in.description: CheckIn overrides limits.check_in when set; a set 0 means no check-in, distinct from leaving it unset.

time.description: Time overrides limits.agent_time and limits.check_in (and the class's or process's, if set) for the project's tasks: most specific wins, a project's own file over the process, the process over the class.

month_eur.description: MonthEUR caps the project's tasks together per UTC calendar month; 0 stops the project's spend.

task_max_eur.description: TaskMaxEUR is the project's own maximum for one card, up to the policy's task_max_eur; absent: a large card's budget.

budget.description: Budget caps the spend of the project's tasks together; absent: the project has no cap of its own. Stricter wins: bounded by policy.yaml's budget.month_eur and budget.task_max_eur; a looser file is rejected.

model.description: Model runs a coding card's first session on Models.Stronger instead of the ladder's first rung; the only accepted value is "stronger". Absent: a coding card starts on the first rung. The planner and report sessions keep their own rung.
Model is the LiteLLM alias the project agent calls (purpose operator).

monthly_eur.description: MonthlyEUR is the budget of the project's chat task each UTC month; absent or 0: the policy's.

confirm.description: Confirm are the tools a member must OK: a call proposes, and the member's Do it runs it. An empty list runs every tool at once.

chat.description: Chat is the project agent's block for this project; its keys replace the policy's.

title: factory/project
description: ProjectConfig is projects/<name>.yaml: one project, the file name its name (rulings 146, 179).
